task: Repair imported generic ReturnValue authority for source-free Section 1 checked bodies.
observation: The generic provider ReturnValue fact was present after specialization, but its EST context was empty: Section 1 projection had been created before a concrete specialization existed, and checker lookup only searched base/source contexts. X1 v10 therefore found a requirement and fact but rejected the absent exact EST authority.
impact: Materializing only the closed checker specialization TypeRef at the exact imported ReturnValue handle and specialization context restores the source-free call without a consumer fallback. The focused harness now verifies drop, context perturbation, duplicate fact, and wrong specialization fail closed.

resolution.summary: X1 v9/v10, Phase 27 .mossi EST, and ReturnValue authority Default/Shadow gates pass on the isolated candidate; final C3 rerun and independent review remain outstanding.

task: Preserve exact checker ReturnValue authority for source-free multi-hop generic imported calls.
observation: The three-hop source-free chain specialized a zero-argument relay as both Vector[Int] and Vector[Bool], but both specializations shared the same function context because context identity included parameter types only. The projected root EST type could also remain open after the checker had selected a closed return TypeRef.
impact: A stable specialization identity in the ReturnValue EST context and exact source-free checked-body occurrence identity allow the checker to materialize the selected closed TypeRef without changing other ownership facts. The registered gate proves Default/Shadow drop, duplicate, context/type/specialization perturbations fail closed in checker, Native and Fast Debug; the crossed Int corruption leaves the Bool sibling intact.

resolution.summary: Dev build and registered WP1 gate pass after diagnostic cleanup; ABI-v9 source-backed controls also pass. Full suites/oracle and independent reviews remain pending.

task: Repair focused validation harnesses for exact specialization-scoped ReturnValue authority.
observation: The Phase27 `.mossi` corruption test removed the old `source:<file>:<line>` EST fact. The generic ABI-v9 call still passed because the checker now authorizes that return from its exact specialization-scoped EST fact. The WP1 job also ran under `moss-opt`, which omits `MOSS_TEST_BUILD` corruption hooks.
impact: The Phase27 harness now drops and perturbs the exact selected generic specialization fact and still exercises normal ABI-v9 provider/app `.mossi` builds and execution. `run_parallel` routes WP1 to `moss-dev`, so registered corruption cases execute rather than silently skipping test hooks.

resolution.summary: Focused WP1 gate passed in Default and Shadow; Phase27 `.mossi` gate passed with equal Default/Shadow artifacts and generic plus Section2 imported bodies.
